title: Fix booking submission and admin notification flow end-to-end

requirements.text: Perform a full end-to-end audit and fix of the booking form submission pipeline in BookingForm.tsx and the backend createBooking function in backend/main.mo. Verify that the Motoko createBooking function accepts all required fields (serviceType, bookingCategory, name, phone, preferredDate, preferredTime, optional message) as the correct Motoko variant/text types, and that the frontend serialises each field into exactly the shape the backend expects before calling the actor. If any field type mismatch or missing argument is found, fix both the backend function signature and the frontend call site. On success, the mutation must return the new booking record (including the assigned booking ID). On failure, display 'Booking failed. Please check your details and try again.'

quotes: No booking available or notification coming fix it

acceptanceCriteria: Filling out all booking form fields and clicking Submit successfully stores a new booking in the backend without throwing an error.
The backend createBooking function accepts all current fields including preferredTime.
The frontend useCreateBooking mutation correctly maps form state to the backend call arguments.
A successful submission returns a booking ID and displays the confirmation message with the booking ID.
A failed submission displays the user-friendly error message.

requirements.text: After a successful booking submission, ensure the post-submission confirmation screen in BookingForm.tsx reliably displays: (1) a prominent 'Notify Admin via WhatsApp' button linking to 'https://wa.me/918689838590?text=<urlencoded message>' where the message includes the booking ID, customer name, phone, service type, booking category, preferred date, preferred time, and optional message, prefixed with 'New Booking from Website'; and (2) a 'Notify Admin via Email' button opening a mailto link to ptripathy1989@gmail.com with subject 'New Booking – Omm Vedic Numerloggy' and body containing all booking details. Both buttons must only appear after a confirmed successful submission (i.e., after the mutation returns success and a valid booking ID). Verify that the booking ID from the backend response is correctly interpolated into both links.

quotes: No booking available or notification coming fix it

acceptanceCriteria: After a successful form submission, the WhatsApp notification button is visible and links to 'https://wa.me/918689838590?text=...' with all booking details URL-encoded.
After a successful form submission, the email notification button is visible and opens a pre-filled mailto link to ptripathy1989@gmail.com with correct subject and body.
Both buttons are hidden or absent before submission or on submission failure.
The booking ID returned from the backend is present in both the WhatsApp message text and the email body.
The WhatsApp message text starts with 'New Booking from Website'.

requirements.text: Audit the useCreateBooking hook in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts to confirm it correctly calls the backend actor's createBooking method, awaits the result, and surfaces both the returned booking record and any error variant to the calling component. If the backend returns a variant result type (e.g., #ok(booking) / #err(message)), ensure the hook unwraps the variant and throws an error for the #err case so React Query's onError/isError state is triggered correctly in BookingForm.tsx.

quotes: No booking available or notification coming fix it

acceptanceCriteria: The useCreateBooking hook returns the created booking record (with ID) in the mutation's data on success.
The useCreateBooking hook throws or rejects with an error message when the backend returns an #err variant.
BookingForm.tsx correctly reads the booking ID from the mutation result to display in the confirmation screen.
BookingForm.tsx correctly detects mutation failure and shows the error message.

constraints: Do not remove or alter any existing SEO meta tags, JSON-LD structured data, or visual styling.
Do not change any frontend routes or navigation structure.
The admin principal and access control logic in backend/main.mo must remain unchanged.
WhatsApp number must remain exactly 918689838590 with no spaces.
nonGoals: Adding new form fields beyond what already exists.
Changing the visual design, color theme, or layout of any page.
Auto-sending WhatsApp or email messages without user click action.
Adding real-time push notifications or server-side email sending.
